experience.detail: (AI-first interview and hiring platform) – San Francisco, CA

bullets.text: Turned Genpact's ban on outsourced final rounds into FlairX's client-run interview suite; led the product and engineering team to ship M365 scheduling with transcript-grounded AI scoring in 2 weeks.
Found recruiters manually rebuilding criteria FlairX already owned; turned each JD, questionnaire, and rubric into a prefilled search plus evidence-grounded candidate ranking.

experience.detail: (SE Asia ride-hailing super app serving 20M+ riders) – Gurgaon, India

bullets.text: Separated price-sensitive abandonment from quote-latency drop-off using funnel analysis, elasticity modelling and 20+ rider interviews; launched a cost-tiered ride product which lifted conversion 9% and generated $3.2M in incremental revenue.
Traded ±4% fare-quote accuracy for sub-second response by pre-caching pricing across 12 high-demand corridors, cutting quote latency 70% and recovering ~28K monthly rides lost to abandonment.

Owned Gojek’s fleet integration platform and partner operating model from definition through launch; replaced bespoke builds with a standardized API and validation workflow, growing supply 18% and cutting pickup ETAs by 1.5 minutes across Singapore and Bali.

Recognized that Job Monitoring was treated as an internal debugging afterthought; reshaped it as an audit-ready product surface, reducing pipeline failure identification time 40% and making it the primary evidence artifact evaluators needed during trial-to-close.

Drove Hevo 2.0's shift to a batch-first transactional model after Fortune 500 trials stalled on auditability, not feature depth; traded streaming speed for verifiable correctness and clear failure boundaries, improving stability 45% and onboarding 8 enterprise customers in 90 days.

experience.detail: (QuickBooks Online, MSE: Monetization Services & Experiences) – Bengaluru, India

bullets.text: Diagnosed silent SMB cancellations as billing accuracy failures, not product gaps; designed reconciliation across three billing services serving 80K+ businesses and presented the financial impact to senior leadership, securing a roadmap pivot from feature velocity to auditability.

Coordinated an 8-team incident response after lifecycle-state mismatches across billing services canceled subscriptions for 1,500+ businesses; ran fix-writing and validation in parallel rather than in sequence, cutting recovery from days to hours.

experience.detail: (health-tech & data-analytics arm of UnitedHealth Group) – Gurgaon, India

bullets.text: Prototyped an ML-based affordability engine; defined feature inputs, evaluation metrics, and deployment workflow, aligning clinical stakeholders and securing pilot approval as part of Optum's global innovation program.
